children: Floor & Decor (NYSE: FND), the leading high-growth retailer specializing in hard-surface flooring for homeowners and professionals, today announced it will open its relocated warehouse store and design center in Clearwater, FL, on Monday, September 28, at 21311 US-19 North. The new location will offer Clearwater-area homeowners and Pros access to the same broad in-stock selection, everyday low prices, and expert service they've come to rely on, just down the road from its previous home.

The Clearwater store will open for business on Monday, September 28, with a team of approximately 45 associates and will be led by Ed Brashares, the store's Chief Executive Merchant. The previous location at 21760 US-19 North will close its doors at the end of business on Sunday, September 27, ensuring a seamless transition with no interruption in service.

Floor & Decor operates more than 280 warehouse-format stores and five design studios nationwide and offers a broad assortment of in-stock hard-surface flooring, including tile, wood, laminate, vinyl, and natural stone, along with decorative accessories and wall tile, installation materials, and related categories at everyday low prices.

"We're excited to welcome our Clearwater customers to our new home on US-19 North," said Ed Brashares. "This move makes it easier than ever for homeowners and Pros to stop in, find what they need, and get their projects moving. We look forward to continuing to serve this community and helping bring our customers' ideas to life."
Floor & Decor will host a Ribbon Cutting Ceremony on Monday, September 28 at 10:30 a.m. ET, in partnership with Amplify Clearwater, to celebrate the opening of the new store.

Floor & Decor will host a PRO Event on Thursday, October 1 from 5–8 p.m. ET, connecting local contractors and trade professionals with product demonstrations, exclusive Pro resources, and prize giveaways totaling $10,000. For more information, visit
Store Hours: Monday–Friday 7 a.m.–8 p.m.; Saturday 8 a.m.–7 p.m.; Sunday 10 a.m.–6 p.m. ET

Floor & Decor is a multi-channel specialty retailer of hard surface flooring and related accessories and seller of commercial surfaces. As of June 25, 2026, the Company operated 281 warehouse-format stores and five design studios across 39 states. The Company offers a broad in-stock assortment of laminate and vinyl, tile, wood, and natural stone flooring and installation materials and decorative accessories, as well as adjacent categories, at everyday low prices. The Company was founded in 2000 and is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia.
